notes.title: Controversial horror sequel Deadly Premonition 2 is cheaper than ever
notes.notes:
How do you even begin to make a sequel to something like Deadly Premonition? It's a challenge I wouldn't even know how to start, with the risks of getting it wrong far, far too high. The original game was a Twin Peaks-esque masterpiece that melded a sense of place with lashings of wonderful weirdness, and despite some pretty big problems it all somehow worked. The sequel, Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise hasn't quite hit all the highs of the original, but at a new historical low price I have to wonder - does it matter?

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Finally, Deadly Premonition 2 is coming to a platform powerful enough to handle it

notes.title: Surprise, surprise: Deadly Premonition 2 is NOW available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514880/d9b80ca34f8103ae20a5293721e5cf58dbf0f4dc.jpg[/img]

Surprise, suprise, folks!

Have you ever heard the saying "there's life in the old dog yet"? Let's let the cat out of the bag then: As of NOW [b]Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise[/b], the latest entry in the cult series, is available on Steam:

[previewyoutube=7i9hdxYqAcI;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Deadly Premonition 2: A Blessing in Disguise[/b] is both a sequel and a prequel to Deadly Premonition, following Agent Davis and Agent Jones as they begin a new investigation into the Le Carré serial murders. Set in present-day Boston, the game’s unique storytelling will see you travel back in time to the town of Le Carré via the memories of a former FBI agent. These flashbacks will allow you to step into the shoes of Special Agent York to unravel an intriguing and disturbing mystery.

The PC version brings with it a number of technical improvements: Players can explore Boston and Le Carré in higher resolution, undertake their investigations with more fluidity thanks to reduced loading times and enjoy the improved performance overall.

Cheers and see you all in Le Carré!
Yours Toybox Inc. & Rising Star Games


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271100/Deadly_Premonition_2_A_Blessing_in_Disguise/
